clause: During the term, Consultant shall not operate a business competing with Client's payroll services.
For twelve months, Seller may not establish a rival dental practice within ten miles of the sold practice.
Buyer shall obtain all of its packaging requirements solely from Supplier.
Distributor shall sell Manufacturer's products through no other supply partner for this territory.
Supplier shall not approach Customer's clients to offer them replacement services.
Neither party may seek business from accounts introduced by the other party.
Client shall not recruit or hire any of Contractor's employees during the engagement.
Neither party may entice the other party's personnel to leave their employment.
Neither party shall make statements intended to damage the other's reputation.
Vendor must refrain from publicly belittling Customer or its business practices.
Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon thirty days' written notice.
Customer may end the engagement for any reason by notifying Provider ten days in advance.
Supplier must obtain Customer's consent before a merger that gives another entity voting control of Supplier.
Customer may end this Agreement if a buyer acquires a majority of Provider's shares.
Neither party may assign this Agreement to a third party without the other's written approval.
A party must notify its counterparty before transferring its contractual rights and duties to another entity.
Provider shall remit fifteen percent of receipts from the service to Customer.
The parties shall divide the net earnings from product sales equally.
Supplier may not increase the unit price by more than three percent in any calendar year.
Reseller must not sell the equipment below the agreed price floor.
Buyer must purchase at least five hundred units each quarter.
Customer shall spend no less than ten thousand dollars on services each year.
Usage above ten thousand requests per month incurs an additional fee per request.
Customer must obtain approval before adding more than two hundred active users.
All copyright in deliverables created by Consultant shall vest solely in Client.
Developer hereby transfers ownership of inventions produced under this engagement to Customer.
The parties shall own jointly all patents arising from their collaborative research.
Each party holds an equal undivided ownership interest in the software they develop together.
Owner authorizes Customer to reproduce the training materials for internal workshops.
Publisher grants Partner permission to display its photographs in the campaign.
The existing software license is personal to Customer and may not be transferred to anyone else.
Licensee may not convey its licensed usage rights to another entity.
The existing license permits use by any number of users without a usage ceiling.
Customer's licensed deployment may cover unlimited installations throughout the enterprise.
The existing license continues forever and cannot be revoked by Licensor.
Customer's licensed rights survive indefinitely with no end date.
Developer shall deposit source code with an independent custodian for release to Customer if Developer becomes insolvent.
Vendor must lodge the program's source files with an escrow agent who will release them if Vendor ceases business.
After this Agreement ends, Provider shall assist migration to a replacement supplier for sixty days.
Upon expiry, Vendor shall continue transition support until Customer's data has been exported.
Customer may inspect Supplier's books and records to verify compliance with this Agreement.
Provider shall allow Client's independent examiner access to its premises to check contractual performance.
Supplier's liability for breach has no monetary ceiling.
Customer may recover the full amount of loss caused by Vendor's breach without any contractual maximum.
Each party's total liability for breach shall not exceed the fees paid in the preceding year.
Claims under this Agreement must be brought within one year after the relevant breach.
For each day of late delivery, Supplier shall pay the agreed sum of five hundred dollars as liquidated damages.
The parties fix compensation for a missed milestone at ten thousand dollars, payable upon that breach.
Contractor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance naming Client as an additional insured.
Vendor must keep a professional indemnity policy in force for Customer's benefit throughout the engagement.
